entries.title: Psalms 27:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> The LORD [is] my light and my salvation; Whom shall I fear? The LORD [is] the strength of my life; Of whom shall I be afraid?

entries.title: Psalms 27:2
segments: When the wicked came against me To eat up my flesh, My enemies and foes, They stumbled and fell.

entries.title: Psalms 27:3
segments: Though an army may encamp against me, My heart shall not fear; Though war should rise against me, In this I [will be] confident.

entries.title: Psalms 27:4
segments: One [thing] I have desired of the LORD, That will I seek: That I may dwell in the house of the LORD All the days of my life, To behold the beauty of the LORD, And to inquire in His temple.

entries.title: Psalms 27:5
segments: For in the time of trouble He shall hide me in His pavilion; In the secret place of His tabernacle He shall hide me; He shall set me high upon a rock.

entries.title: Psalms 27:6
segments: And now my head shall be lifted up above my enemies all around me; Therefore I will offer sacrifices of joy in His tabernacle; I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 27:7
segments: ¶Hear, O LORD, [when] I cry with my voice! Have mercy also upon me, and answer me.

entries.title: Psalms 27:8
segments: [When You said], "Seek My face," My heart said to You, "Your face, LORD, I will seek."

entries.title: Psalms 27:9
segments: Do not hide Your face from me; Do not turn Your servant away in anger; You have been my help; Do not leave me nor forsake me, O God of my salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 27:10
segments: When my father and my mother forsake me, Then the LORD will take care of me.

entries.title: Psalms 27:11
segments: Teach me Your way, O LORD, And lead me in a smooth path, because of my enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 27:12
segments: Do not deliver me to the will of my adversaries; For false witnesses have risen against me, And such as breathe out violence.

entries.title: Psalms 27:13
segments: [I would have lost heart], unless I had believed That I would see the goodness of the LORD In the land of the living.

entries.title: Psalms 27:14
segments: Wait on the LORD; Be of good courage, And He shall strengthen your heart; Wait, I say, on the LORD!
